raw_response:
1. The figure does not show confidence intervals or error bars for “DPR w/ top-1,” so you can’t infer widening intervals or increasing uncertainty from this plot. It only shows point estimates across query counts.  
2. At 10 queries, “DPR w/ top-1” is actually higher (≈36.4) than “DPR w/ curriculum” (≈35.8), so curriculum does not outperform top-1 there. The “top-1” curve also does not plateau at 35.8 in this figure; it continues rising past 36.0.  
3. The plot provides no statistical test results or variance estimates, so the p-value and significance of the difference between “DPR w/ top-1” and “DPR w/ random” at 10 queries cannot be determined from the figure.
